sentences.text: This is a petition filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 by the accused in Crime No.163/2023 of Vanitha Police Station, Kasaragod, which is pending as CC.

on the file of the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Kasaragod The offences alleged against the petitioner are punishable under Sections 498A , 341 and 323 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860 2.

The prosecution case is that the accused being the husband of the defacto complainant subjected her to cruelty both physically and mentally on the ground of dowry and thereby he alleged to have committed the aforesaid offence.
3. According to the petitioner, the dispute has been settled with the defacto complainant and the 3rd respondent and they agreed to drop all further proceedings relating to the above dispute.

Therefore,
the petitioner prayed for quashing all further proceedings against him.
4. The Defacto complainant and the other aggrieved person have filed affidavits endorsing the averments in the Criminal MC.
According to them, the case has been amicably settled and that they does not intend to proceed with the case and also that further proceedings in the case can be quashed.
They have no further grievance against the petitioner.

5. The learned Public Prosecutor, after getting instruction from the investigating officer also Abdul Ashim M vs State Of Kerala on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187607119/
2 submitted that the dispute has been settled between the parties and that the respondents 2 and 3 are not at all interested in continuing the prosecution against the petitioner.

sentences.text: 6. Considering the fact that the offence involved in this case are not heinous and very serious, but purely of private in nature and now the dispute has been settled between the parties, this is a fit case in which further proceedings can be quashed by invoking the inherent power of this court.
Such a course is also required to maintain the harmonious relationship between the parties to a marriage and also to prevent abuse of process of the court.
In the result, this Crl. M.C is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioner/accused in CC. No.19/2023 on the file of the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Kasaragod arising from crime No.163/2022 of Vanitha Police Station, Kasaragod stands quashed under Section 528 of B.N.S.S.
